movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle E-Business Suite Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle E-Business Suite contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Runtime component of Oracle Configurator. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

movers24h.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure), Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti Neurons contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the SAML component that allows an attacker to access certain restricted resources without authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web component that allows an attacker to access restricted resources by bypassing control checks. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2024-21887, a command injection vulnerability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Progress WS_FTP Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Progress WS_FTP Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Ad Hoc Transfer module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute remote commands on the underlying operating system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Insecure Direct Object Reference Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in RadAsyncUpload that can result in file uploads in a limited location and/or remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41040 which allows for the remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Externally Controlled Reference Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Word. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability can run code with the privileges of the calling application.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv1 Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS Improper Authorization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat on Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: When running Apache Tomcat on Windows with HTTP PUTs enabled, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMB Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain an input validation issue in a JavaScript method that could potentially lead to remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: An authenticated attacker could leverage improper validation in cmdlet arguments within Microsoft Exchange and perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Exim Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Exim contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the base64d function part of the SMTP listener that may allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote code execution in the context of the current user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office and WordPad Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office and WordPad contain an unspecified vulnerability due to the way the applications parse specially crafted files. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers24h.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Missing Authorization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Search contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file, leading to remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted packet.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability leads to Remote Code Execution

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: BQE BillQuick Web Suite SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: BQE BillQuick Web Suite contains an SQL injection vulnerability when accessing the username parameter that may allow for unauthenticated, remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0798.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ZK Framework AuUploader Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Microsoft JScript nd VBScript engines, as used in Internet Explorer and other products, allow attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player com.adobe.tvsdk.mediacore.metadata Use After Free Vulnerability

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

movers24h.product: Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the WebVPN login page. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via an unspecified parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Resource Management Errors Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to steal and send emails of a victim via a crafted e-mail message that abuses a Desanitization issue in message_body() in program/actions/mail/show.php.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: NAKIVO Backup and Replication Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: NAKIVO Backup and Replication contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that enables an attacker to read arbitrary files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ImageMagick Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass Windows Defender SmartScreen checks and their associated prompts.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) SNMP Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) code of Cisco ASA software could allow an attacker to cause a reload of the affected system or to remotely execute code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sudo contains an off-by-one error that can result in a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) products contain an improper neutralization of a SQL Command leading to SQL injection.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances Arbitrary Code Execution
movers7d.shortDescription: On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: When running Apache Tomcat, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server.

movers7d.product: ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: HP Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Shell (.lnk) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Windows Shell in multiple versions of Microsoft Windows allows local users or remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted .LNK file

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: October CMS Improper Authentication
movers7d.shortDescription: In affected versions of the october/system package an attacker can request an account password reset and then gain access to the account using a specially crafted request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ExifTool Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Improper neutralization of user data in the DjVu file format in Exiftool versions 7.44 and up allows arbitrary code execution when parsing the malicious image

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Struts REST Plugin uses an XStreamHandler with an instance of XStream for deserialization without any type filtering, which can lead to remote code execution when deserializing XML payloads.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution under two circumstances. One, where the alwaysSelectFullNamespace option is true and the value isn't set for a result defined in underlying configurations and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace.  Or, using URL tag which doesn't have value and action set and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS) Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Rockwell Multiple Products Insufficient Protected Credentials Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Missing Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Grafana Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Grafana contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow access to local files.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

newest.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
